question: Should OpenClaw publish this provider-neutral external-verification Gateway contract as a stable additive API now, or defer it until the companion plugin-SDK and executable runtime slices are ready?
rationale: The patch is intentionally inert but exposes generated client-facing protocol data; source review cannot determine whether maintainers want to freeze that public contract independently of the rest of the accepted design.

options.title: Publish the stable foundation now
options.body: Merge the additive contract and treat its bounded label and decision shape as a compatibility commitment for the subsequent implementation slices.

options.title: Land with the executable path
options.body: Defer this public protocol addition until the plugin SDK and first host-owned runtime flow are ready to ship together.

recommendation.title: Publish the stable foundation now
recommendation.body: Merge the additive contract and treat its bounded label and decision shape as a compatibility commitment for the subsequent implementation slices.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the linked tracker and companion implementation, and can supply the technical contract rationale for maintainer acceptance.
